decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (248-100-AL (02), 248-101-AL (02), 248-102-AL (02), 248-103-AL (02), 248-110-AL (02), 248-111-AL (02), 248-120-AL (02) and Flood Risk Assessment Received: 07 October 2011 
248-140-AL (04), 248-141-AL (04), 248-142-AL (04), 248-143-AL (04), 248-150-AL (05), 248-151-AL (05), 248-160-AL (06) Received: 09 December 2011)  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The west side elevation of the rear extension shall be obscurely glazed and fixed shut and permanently retained in that condition thereafter
description: Erection of a single storey rear and rear infill extension to the house
